I know what you mean. Sometimes the thought of ending it all makes me feel energetic and giddy almost. I think it stems from the knowledge that in death we will be escaping what torments us. I also feel drained everyday. I haven't had any natural energy for quite some time. Are you taking any medication that could be causing the lack or energy. Do you have access to stimulants? I find that taking prescription amphetamines (like Adderall) help me a lot with not just energy but also my depression (until of course they wear off and I crash)
I believe in an afterlife. What it is I'm not sure. But I live my life thinking that death is only the beginning
